9449.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Formed from unadorned grey stone, the corridor is neat and tidy. title: [Bluerock Brewery, Corridor]
9450.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Giant piles of grain are neatly kept in enormous bins in this large storage facility encased by four walls of thick granite rock. Huge vats of water stand nearby, soaking ample quantities of oats and barley.  A steady flow of malt-laden carts pass through a reinforced invar arch to the west, only to return empty.
title: [Bluerock Brewery, Grain Silo]
9451.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The metal shelves of this shop are crammed full of assorted knick knacks, weapons, armor, containers, and many types of unrecognizable items. Several ladders lean against the shelves to facilitate retrieval of items from the upper levels.  Larger items occupy places on the floor.  In the midst of it all, an old dwarf totters around, using a cane for support as he straightens the displays.
title: [Hortemeyer's Pre-Owned Goods]
9477.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This backroom contains several tables, a bright metal sign, and boxes piled upon boxes. Several dwarven clerks paw through the boxes as if looking for certain ones.  From time to time, a clerk will grab one of the boxes and rush out, often returning with the same box and a puzzled look.
title: [Hortemeyer's Resales]
9478.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A damp, earthy smell permeates this shop and the light-giving potted mushrooms seen everywhere in town are almost lost in the profusion of other fungi. title: [Marcketel Mushroom Exporters]
9479.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Three displays dominate this small shop. A narrow marble table nestles between the two displays.  The proprietor keeps a sharp eye on the customers from behind a U-shaped granite counter, and a curtain on the east wall apparently allows egress to another room.  The counter's shape completely blocks patrons from using this curtain.
title: [Brutarius Kodel Weaponry]
9480.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The heavy scent of pine tar mixes with the odor of ale and cooked delicacies. The sounds of revelry and the clink of mugs appear to come from beyond the stone arch.  Dwarves in assorted garb enter and go east or through the arch, though those dressed in rougher attire seem to prefer the arch.  The patrons entering also seem to be much less inebriated than those exiting.  The patrons tread over an expansive oval rug, and silhouettes of larger-than-life musical instruments hang on the walls.
title: [Bawdy Bard Inn, Entry]
9481.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A low stone counter wraps around a small private space, providing a place for the innkeeper to do business separate from the customer area. 9482.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

9483.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The hallway comes to an end.  To the east, a lone toadstool rests in a large stone pot just in front of a bare granite wall. These are shored up by thick cedar timbers.  Thick green carpet provides the only vibrant coloration.  A faux-oak door breaks up the monotony of the south wall while a faux-walnut door breaches the north wall.
title: [Bawdy Bard Inn, Hallway]
9484.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Completely covering the low dome ceiling are a sea of brightly dyed tapestries woven with the glorified images of bards engrossed in their artistry. 9485.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A perfectly circular room provides snug sleeping quarters.  White woolen carpet covers the floor from wall to wall, and cotton sheeting in the same white shade hides the ceiling. 9486.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A short, narrow entry widens out into an oval-shaped room. 9487.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

9488.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A long narrow room extends northward from the faux-maple door on the south wall. 9489.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

16837.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

title: [Bluerock Brewery, Office]
16838.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Two orderly rows of large copper kettles span the length of this massive room, carefully monitored by dwarven workers clad in white smocks. title: [Bluerock Brewery, Brewhouse]
16839.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Rows of large barrels, kegs and casks lying on their side fill most of the expansive room, the wooden containers nestled into hollow, stacked stone racks. title: [Bluerock Brewery, Storage]
16840.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Lined up against the grey north wall is a row of copper mash tuns. Attending each tun is a stoic-faced dwarf who carefully monitors the grist, the mashing and lautering processes.
title: [Bluerock Brewery, Mash Tun]
16841.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: In an attempt to maximize productivity, the steam generated by a blackened iron furnace powers several mills through a series of wheels and gears. Tall steel hoppers are kept filled with malt from the north, in preparation to be milled.  A series of grist cases house the already milled grain.
title: [Bluerock Brewery, Millroom]
16842.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Detailed busts of notable dwarves and their beards rest upon a simple ledge that runs the length of the far wall. The chamber is cast in a cheerful light by the glowing toadstools situated at each corner.
title: [Fashionable Face Fur]
16848.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Small humus pots suspended from the ceiling cast donut-shaped pools of light across the stone floor of this cramped tavern. 16849.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Enticing, savory aromas drift through a set of steel-braced double doors flanked by potted, luminescent toadstools. A dark stairway is visible just beyond a large, arched alcove built into the eastern wall.

17892.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Clear glaes windows have been inset along the reflective black marble walls of this long hallway.  In the spaces between, polished brass pots house the giant, luminescent toadstools used for lighting.

description: A pair of giant, luminescent toadstools occupy a large alcove opposite the eastern branching corridor.  The oversized fungi have faintly mottled caps that shed a diffuse bluish light upon the polished black marble.
title: [Rogue Guild, Hallway]

description: Reflective black marble spans as far as the eye can see, stretching down long corridors and into shadow.  Occasional footfalls can be heard, resounding against the stone floor. title: [Rogue Guild, Antechamber]

description: Spanning half the length of the southern wall is a gleaming gold-speckled bar and thick glaes shelves lined with colorful bottles. title: [Rogue Guild, Lounge]
17899.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Several mismatched chairs have been gathered closely around a polished glaes-inlaid table.  A nearby giant glowing toadstool sheds a soft white light, gleaming off the bottles lining the wall.
title: [Rogue Guild, Trollfear Table]

description: A round glaes-inlaid table occupies much of the space in this quiet booth.  The cushy, leather-covered bench smells faintly of ale, lingering from drinks spilled in the past.  A red sphene toadstool charm has been tacked onto the back wall.
title: [Rogue Guild, Genkew Booth]
17901.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Tiny flecks of cloudy quartz crystal in the floor pick up the greenish hue of the light shed by the nearby giant toadstools.  Carved into the ceiling is a faint design vaguely resembling runes, though it is far too symmetric to be anything but decorative.
title: [Rogue Guild, East Hall]
17902.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Shallow carvings adorn the black marble, creating mesmerizing designs of light and shadow in the presence of strategically placed luminescent toadstools. title: [Rogue Guild, East Hall]
17903.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Rich, amber-hued marble and burnished copper fixtures accent the spacious office of the Guild Master. description: Chiseled into the mountainside by the extreme weather conditions, the narrow, snow-covered trail follows the natural contour of an intensely steep ridge. title: [Dragonspine, Snowy Trail]
34279.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Creamy white blankets of freshly fallen snow combined with the shadowing effects of the moonlight greatly interfere with one's ability to locate the existing trail versus the edge of the mountain. title: [Dragonspine, Snowy Trail]
34280.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Cramped clusters of spruce trees decorate the grey-white landscape and compete for space along the narrow trail, their limbs sagging tirelessly beneath the weight of fresh snow. title: [Dragonspine, Snowy Trail]
34281.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Deceivingly larger than expected, this cave is comprised of a sturdy rock ledge with ample room for a few adventurers, a small campfire, and a vast, open space that plummets to the depths below. Plumes of steam rise from the platform edge and disperse along the ceiling to refreeze and replenish the ceaseless ice formations.
title: [Dragonspine, Frozen Cave]
34282.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Blue-green crystalline waters provide a peaceful and tranquil surrounding, stark in contrast to the frigid and frosty conditions high above. title: [Stormpeak Base, Shimmer Cove]
34283.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Vivid accents of purple columbine and pink windflowers interspersed between lavish clumps of feather grass surround the lake and elicit a visual explosion alongside the dramatic blue-green water.  Rippling shadows of the silhouetted Dragonspine dance across the glassy surface, a natural camoflauge to the plentiful orefish that call this place home.  Thick with river birch and silver maples, the surrounding wetlands serve as a partial barricade from the gusting winds beyond the area's perimeter.
title: [Stormpeak Base, Shimmer Lake]
34284.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Abundantly moist and spongy underfoot, a nauseating mixture of fish, flora, and rotting vegetation seeps into the air with each step, and an audible *SQUISH* alerts any awaiting predators of your presence.  Vultures soar high in the skies above, waiting for their next meal to appear within striking distance.  To the east, a shimmering lake serves as a large repository for the runoff from the majestic waterfall visible in the distance.
title: [Stormpeak Base, Lake's Edge]
34285.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Flowing swiftly from east to west with a down-sloped southern curve, a wide stream bisects the ground and separates the more inaccessible and treacherous section along the south edge from the traversible north side. title: [Stormpeak Base, Stream Bed]
34286.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Completely surrounded by unnavigable boulders save a single moss-covered ramp with a precarious incline, this landing offers some shelter from what appears to be a high-precipitation area beyond.  Luxuriant vegetation rich with deep greens and patterned shrubbery paints a painting-perfect backdrop to this mud and stone-filled space around the natural embankment.  Painstakingly manicured to remove obstacles and unsightly overgrowth, the trail from the landing is precipitous but viable.
title: [Giant's Ridge, Landing]
34287.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Originating from an upper ridge along Thunder Plateau, a frothy waterfall seizes both power and grace in one of this landscape's most elegant creations.  Named for its movement along the spiny ridges of the mountain and its resemblance to that of a dragon and its tail, Dragon Falls is a popular attraction among locals and tourists.  Fine mist lingers in the air, dampening an over-soggy terrain and safeguarding this land from becoming more than a wonderous sightseeing spot at the mountain's base.
title: [Stormpeak Base, Dragon Falls]
34288.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: With the mountain face to the east and the open range to the west, the winds of the region are unforgiving, and there is little to no shelter.  Mist from a nearby waterfall keeps the rock wall in a perpetual clammy state, and an odd layer of mold has grown along many fallen branches and rotting logs.  Secured to the mountain side are two iron tracks, and a large wooden cage is attached to a series of metal poles and steel wires.
title: [Stormpeak Base, Shimmer Valley]
34289.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Long tree branches bend and extend across the trail from both sides, a moderately protective canopy from recurring rainstorms. A tremendous boom of thunder followed by a distant flash of light and the crackling of a tree branch ripping away from its birthplace is commonplace.
title: [Giant's Ridge, Lower Trail]
34290.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Nearing the top of the ridge, an overview of the outlying area makes a brief appearance through a sheer veil of clouds.  Winding around the edge of the mountain is a clear-cut trail that carves its way through thick growth and a somewhat rocky terrain.  Low-lying clouds impede visibility, but the superiority of the marked trail makes the journey more tolerant.
title: [Giant's Ridge, Lower Trail]
34291.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Impeding further travel to the east is a wall of tremendous boulders, a barricade to the immense summit that imposes a foreboding shadow over an already darkened trail.  Freshly cut limbs and branches rest in an orderly pile beneath a covered stand filled with a variety of pruning tools and other miscellaneous items.  Just beyond a wide crevice in the ground, a rock-spattered ledge clings to the mountain face and wends back and forth toward a moderate clearing set back from the trail's sharp edge.
title: [Giant's Ridge, Juncture]
34292.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: With barely enough space to take a deep breath, this thin ledge, which continues across the mountain face and hangs on the precipice of tragedy, supports travelers as they precariously shuffle from one side to the other.  An up close and personal view of the mountain face shows unnoticed or perhaps forgotten details about the aged granite.  The trail appears safely reachable with a fairly effortless leap, but the trek to the south appears a bit more grueling, especially given the weather conditions.
title: [Giant's Ridge, Rocky Ledge]
34293.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Strong winds from the Dragonspine's lower ridges culminate and cause an uneven terrain to become more hazardous for travel.  Large birch trees have succumbed to the powerful gusts, while others have simply become slaves to the environmental demands, bending and swaying without vacillation.  Bits of debris litter the ground and cycle through a sundry list based on the wind's direction - from mushroom caps and flower petals, to fish bones and tufts of fur, this region lives in a state of disarray.
title: [Stormpeak Base, Wetland]
34294.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Generous rains provide an abundance of nourishment for the local flora and a grand home of silver maples. High along the western ridge, flashes of vivid sapphire produce a luminous aura that fades quickly, making it difficult to pinpoint its exact location.  In an effort to sneak past intruders, a small creature scurries across the ground and darts beneath a pile of broken branches.
title: [Stormpeak Base, Shimmer Valley]
34295.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: One of the higher perches at the western end of this region, this small hilltop gives a sufficient overview of the surrounding area. Occasional flashes of sapphire shimmer against the mountain backdrop and periodically compete for attention with the lightning strikes that seem to plague the upper plateau.
title: [Stormpeak Base, Shimmer Valley]
34296.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Distant howls reverberate with an unexpected echo and break any enduring silence, reminding visitors that there are unseen dangers all around. Rising in elevation, the mountain ascent begins to the east, the trail visible all the way to the mountain face.
title: [Stormpeak Base, Shimmer Valley]
34297.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: With an increase in rock-strewn ground cover and a steady incline compared to the western valley, a continued trek to the east will undoubtedly lead to the Dragonspine Mountains.  Its rising form appears to grow with each eastward step, and upper ledges and summits are hidden behind dark shadows, regardless of the hour.  Strikes of bright light appear over a distant plateau, and afterward, a resounding crack of thunder spreads through the region with a rumble strong enough to vibrate along the ground.
title: [Stormpeak Base, Shimmer Valley]
34298.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The moon is rarely given substantial opportunity to peek through the persistant cloud cover, but when the moment arises and the distant lake's surface is pierced, thousands of miniscule pinpoints of light are projected along the ground, twinkling and shimmering like brilliant stars in a clear night sky.  Smaller rocks and piles of rubble take a secondary position to much larger boulders, and reliance on a pre-cleared trail becomes necessary, as deviation from the pathway becomes treacherous and unreliable.
title: [Stormpeak Base, Shimmer Valley]
34299.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Built from indigenous trees, a makeshift shelter is barely enough to keep the elements from soaking the ground and everything underneath.  Thick branches, greenery, a bit of mud, and some sizeable sheets of oilcloth have all been applied to the outside to aid with weatherproofing, though heavy winds manage to keep the refuge in a state of constant repair.  Tucked neatly beneath the wood frame, with space leftover for a few travelers, a hollowed-out tree stump and a smooth cottonwood bench offer a few basic amenities.
title: [Giant's Ridge, Clearing]
34300.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Moisture clings to the verdant grass like glue, the large water droplets elongating past their limit before breaking away to merge with the constant rains.  Lightning strikes nearby, and a thunderous boom across the ridge sends a flurry of creatures running for cover.  Tilted slightly to the left, due largely to the sodden ground, is a handpainted sign that has obviously been repainted a number of times.
title: [Giant's Ridge, Winding Path]
34301.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Steep rises and severe dips in the rocky hills makes travel along this winding path an exhausting undertaking.  Short-lived periods of moonlight peek through ominous storm clouds and cast an illuminating glow upon the darkened land, only to be eclipsed once again by the monopolizing tempest.
title: [Giant's Ridge, Winding Path]
34302.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Boot treads of recent travelers form intricate criss-crossed designs across the muddy pathway in a dizzying array.  Groups of voices can barely be heard beneath the sound of the driving rain, but the inability to locate their source preserves the mystery.  Carved from petrified tree bark, a large composition sits just off the trail and is turned slightly torward the north.
title: [Giant's Ridge, Trailhead]
34303.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Clusters of healthy trees offset similarly sized clearings from recent fires, evident by the scorched and singed flora that managed to escape the runaway burns.  Frequent lightning strikes threaten the lush beauty of the mountain ridge, but the soil appears resilient and continues to sustain and nourish the fugitive vegetation.
title: [Giant's Ridge, Boot Trail]
34304.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Switchbacks with steep inclines weave between thickets and then empty out into large clearings, leaving travelers exposed to the unrelenting weather conditions.  Square blocks cut from granite slabs edge the entire length of the trail to prevent erosion of the pathway.  The techniques and approaches used to establish these trails show a proclivity in resourcefulness as well as extraordinary skill in environmental knowledge and analysis.
title: [Giant's Ridge, Boot Trail]
34305.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A sharp southeast curve makes a lofty descent to a wide stream that spills over stair-like rapids.  Felled timber bound together with long strands of braided, reinforced twine bind the logs together in long planks that stretch from one bank to the other, forming a makeshift bridge.  The top of the wooden structure appears unfazed by the climate, but early stages of decomposition to its underside have begun.  A silvery blue glow backlit by clouded moonlight shimmers along the water's edge.
title: [Giant's Ridge, Boot Trail]
34306.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Crossing a wide stream to connect the western and eastern side of the ridge is a felled-timber bridge that stands a few feet above the rushing water.  Faint outlines of a towering peak, higher than any other visible point in the vicinity, becomes visible when the cloud cover thins to a translucent veil and reveals the hidden beauty.  Intense golden flashes illuminate the sky behind the concealing nimbus in a captivating light show.
title: [Giant's Ridge, Boot Trail]
34307.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Bestowed upon the area from the summit's mighty reign, a foreboding shadow looms over the entire area beyond the dimmed lighting caused by the snuffed-out moon.  A severe drop in temperature beneath the cover of darkness is uncomfortably noticeable, especially since miniscule ice crystals appear to form along the wall of the mountainside before being washed away by a strong rain-filled gust.
title: [Giant's Ridge, Crown View]
34308.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Following the contour of the mountainside, the trail snakes in and out of crevices like a food-seeking reptile, but serves a distinct purpose to keep travelers away from the unstable ground beyond the shield of the summit's shadow.  Charred remains of unknown creatures are piled against the rock, placed intentionally as an offering or moved there by a larger predators is unclear.  Off in the northern distance, a rising trail wavers in and out of view, but appears to lead farther up the mountain.
title: [Giant's Ridge, Crown View]
34309.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Piles of rocks and boulders have accumulated at the base of the trail leading to higher areas of the mountain.  Unskilled climbers falling victim to the harsh demands for passage remain wedged between the ruthless stone graves.
title: [Giant's Ridge, Scree Deposits]
34310.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Arduous and exhausting, the trail is a lesson in patience no matter which direction is traveled.  Unyielding weather conditions and strenuous terrain leave trail-goers completely exposed without any options for shelter at this midway point of the trail.  A quick glimpse of the surrounding area shows the trail all the way from the current location to the pathway's landing -- it looks much like a boot.
title: [Giant's Ridge, Upper Trail]
34311.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: One slip could be the difference between a good night's sleep and a night's sleep for good.  Fortunately, the steep trail has been reinforced with chipped wood and gravel, soaking up some of the mud that causes the trail to become impassable.  While the peak of the trail appears to end in a few hundred feet, the base is still quite a distance away.  A small patch of wildflowers offers a burst of color in an otherwise gloomy area.
title: [Giant's Ridge, Upper Trail]
34312.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: High walls of granite stretch up to the clouds and shimmer faintly behind scattered opaque veils, the unique bioluminescence becoming more prevalent in their dark grey surroundings.  Blocking the path to the west are enormous boulders that have come to rest atop one another, wedged together perfectly like a completed puzzle.  Few gaps exist between the massive rocks, and it doesn't look like climbing them is an option.
title: [Giant's Ridge, Upper Trail]
34313.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: No wider than a couple of feet, it has become increasingly difficult to maneuver along this sturdy strip of stone that cuts in and out of the mountain's natural shape.  Rocks crunch loudly underfoot, and smaller pebbles roll off the ledge and meet an early demise on the ground below.  Fortunately, a small clearing is a short jump over a deep crevice and should provide suitable accommodations for a brief rest.
title: [Giant's Ridge, Rocky Ledge]
34314.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Dense clouds hang in the air with disorienting consequences until an abrupt flurry forces the misty mass to sail away, revealing an opportune glimpse of the muddy ground.  Dangerously close to the edge of the cliff, one miscalculated step could be the deciding factor between life and death.  A few powder blue feathers jut out from the wet dirt, primarily noticeable because of the utter color contrast from the drab brown path that leads away from the precipice.
title: [Thunder Plateau, Brink]

description: Sheets of rain wash violently across the waterlogged terrain that shifts and gradually transforms with each wind gust, creating an abstract landscape of mud lumps. 34325.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

34326.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

34327.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

title: [Thunder Plateau]
34328.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

34329.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

34332.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

title: [Thunder Plateau]
34335.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

34337.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

34341.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

title: [Raining Caves, Tunnel]
34370.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Piles of bones, some with bits of flesh still attached and others gnawed completely clean, are scattered everywhere with nearly every section of ground covered. Thick, long scratch marks around the depression's perimeter suggest it was burrowed by a clawed animal.
title: [Raining Caves, Hound Den]
34371.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Sizeable water droplets rain down upon everything beneath the persistant seepage and leave a layer of moisture along the ground coupled with a thick, suffocating humidity in the air. Strong vibrations shake the earth underfoot and are followed by an extended series of muffled rumblings, though they seem to be originating from outside the caves.
title: [Raining Caves, Tunnel]
34372.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Lighting deficiencies and the constant reverberation of sounds make disorientation commonplace at this point in the entanglement of caves and tunnels. title: [Raining Caves, Tunnel]
34373.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Higher than even the tallest giant, the cavern ceiling opens up to the sky to reveal dark grey stormclouds looming overhead against a nighttime sky. The muffled roar of a neighboring waterfall adds a natural harmony to the sounds of an approaching storm, but extended periods of such auditory stimulation can be deafening.
title: [Raining Caves, Dead End]

description: With even the most careful of steps, the bridge sways back and forth in a precarious manner, creaking and groaning as if it could surrender to its shoddy condition at any moment. Splintered sections of wood detach from the structure's main slats with a distressing crack, similar to that of a bone breaking.

description: Chilled beads of water rain down from the cave's stone canopy, a veil of moisture clouding the main panorama. 34376.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A short overhang provides a temporary reprieve from relentless raindrops falling from the ceiling.  Significantly cooler drafts from above plummet and commingle with the humid, warmer air below, creating a blanket of thick fog that swells and recedes, like ocean waves.
title: [Raining Caves, East Ledge]
34377.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Without an abundance of light, the ability to identify distant objects is difficult at best. Prowling and lurking far below are packs of hounds, some with eyes that cast a green glow, and others whose nostrils erupt a green mist.  Patches of tinged fog rise slowly into the air, but dissipate long before they reach the bridge.
title: [Raining Caves, Rickety Bridge]
34378.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Seemingly suspended between two bridges, the north ledge does not connect with the wall at the floor, making movement somewhat problematic. There are a number of persistent trickles, liquid threads from floor to ceiling, greatly resembling puppet strings.
title: [Raining Caves, North Ledge]
34379.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Deep scrapes and gashes surrounding a deep pit suggest that a clawed creature has either buried a treasure or wants to dig something up. From this ledge, it's difficult to see any detail given the lack of lighting, but there is definite movement at the bottom of the chasm.
title: [Raining Caves, Platform]
34380.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Bouncing with unbridled motion, this fragile link between the west ledge and north ledge quickly becomes a lifebuoy, evidenced by the haggard condition of the once-thick ropes that serve as railings.  An echoing drip-drop sound serves only to distract from the inability to see clearly in this mist-laden area of the cavern.  Slick walls glisten despite sufficient lighting, mostly due to silvery blue flecks imbedded into the stone.
title: [Raining Caves, Rickety Bridge]
34381.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: At the end of a twisting warren of narrow caves, the cold and lightless delve into the earth reaches a series of wider, less claustrophobic tunnels. 5756.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

title: [Mraent Cavern, Granite Tunnel]

title: [Mraent Cavern, Granite Tunnel]
5758.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

title: [Mraent Cavern, Granite Tunnel]
5759.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This enormous space was opened out of the mountain by the work of the stonecutters. title: [Mraent Cavern, Main Quarry]
5760.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

title: [Mraent Cavern, Dodecahedron]
5761.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

title: [Mraent Cavern, Octahedron]
5762.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

title: [Mraent Cavern, Pentagonal Prism]
5763.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

title: [Mraent Cavern, Tetrahedron]

title: [Stonecutters' Lodge, Office]

title: [Stonecutters' Lodge, Dormitory]
5769.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

title: [Mraent Cavern, Garnet Lode]
5771.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

title: [Mraent Cavern, Granite Tunnel]

title: [Mraent Cavern, Granite Wound]
5773.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

5774.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

5775.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Carved into the granite beneath the waterfall quarry, a wide spiraling sluice carries the spillover deep underground.  It is quite difficult to keep your footing on the slick, canting stone.

5780.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

5781.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

5782.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

5783.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

5784.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

5785.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Stream]
5786.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The tunnel floor takes a sharp downturn as it winds northward and the roar of a waterfall makes any further movement in that direction unlikely. 5787.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

5788.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

5789.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Stalactites cluster closely overhead, their dagger-like points a grim reminder of the incalculable weight of rock poised above you. Flickering, but brighter light from the east casts phantasmagoric shadows on the smooth walls.
title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Narrow Passage]
5790.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Luminous insects rise in clouds from a pit to your west, the living motes of light drifting in the air as if in an unseen tide. 5791.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Drifts of refuse have collected between stalagmites rising from the cavern floor, white bones visible amidst the less identifiable debris.  A sharp animal reek pervades the chamber, though its source is invisible in the greenish glow of luminescent fungi festooning the uneven ceiling.
title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Cavern]
5792.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The only way to travel up or down within the smooth and featureless vertical passage is to brace hands and feet along its sides.  Your halting motion along the slick walls is uncomfortably reminescent of peristalsis.
title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Chimney]
5793.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The cavern narrows abruptly to the north and ends in a pit little wider than a stout giantman's shoulders.  The rim of the pit is worn smooth, almost slick.
title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Chimney]
5794.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The curvilinear forms of stalactites and stalagmites are a dramatic contrast to rigidly angular mine shafts. title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Natural Cavern]
5795.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The tunnel ends abruptly in a wall of blank, rough rock.  Veins of metal shimmer in faint light from the south, beautiful to see but apparently not rich enough to mine.
title: [Zaerthu Tunnels]
5796.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Nexus]
5797.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

5798.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Abandoned Mine]
5799.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Abandoned Mine]
5800.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Scanty patches of lichen along the walls serve only to emphasize the profound darkness of the mine shaft.  Rock walls rough enough to abrade skin press close on either side, and a furtive slithering sound occasionally echoes from more distant parts of the tunnel.
title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Abandoned Mine]
5801.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A portion of the tunnel wall has collapsed, leaving the few beams supporting it bowed with the added pressure.  The sound of small stones crunching underfoot as you pass is startlingly loud in the silent mines.
title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Abandoned Mine]
5802.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Dim fungous light and an uneven floor make walking a potentially bone-breaking hazard.  The beams bracing up the rock bear scratches and look none too sturdy despite their girth.
title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Abandoned Mine]
5803.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: An old mining cart, its sides so eaten with rust that faint light from the phosphorescent lichen on the rough rock wall behind it shows through the holes.  Tools scattered near the cart and scraps of dry-rotted cloth tell a story of a hasty, possibly violent exit.
title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Abandoned Mine]
5804.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Fallen beams narrow the mine shaft to no more than a yard's width at points.  A fine sifting of dust covers every available surface, including your skin and hair. title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Abandoned Mine]
5805.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A glimmer of brighter light to the east reveals the surroundings clearly, though there is little of note to see.  The sturdy supports along the mine walls are black with soot in spots and a number of unusually smooth holes mar the ceiling between the beams.
title: [Zaerthu Tunnels]
5806.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A solitary lantern, its flame small but bright, casts a welcome light on the broad passage. title: [Zaerthu Tunnels]
5807.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Spent torches litter one wall of the wide passage and the faint smell of greasy smoke lingers in the air.  Underlying the scent is some more acrid, but unidentifiable odor.  Faint, but warm light emanates from somewhere to the south.
title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Main Tunnel]
5808.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Subterranean creatures scratch furtively in fissures lining the rock walls of the tunnel, clearly heard but unseen in the ghostly light of phosphorescent lichen.  Deeper shadows between the ceiling supports mark the position of a series of round holes, each about a giantman's arm-span in diameter.  In the faint illumination, it's impossible to say whether the holes are natural formations or the product of conscious design.
title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Main Tunnel]
5809.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The floor gives way to a gaping pit spanned by a narrow bridge.  Stout pegs driven into the rock support the bridge, which rocks gently in the reeking current of air rising from the depths.  A nearby beam bears scratches that look like writing in the wan fungal glow.
title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Chasm]
5810.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Bridge]
5811.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A humid breeze emanates from the yawning chasm to your west, carrying with it the too-sweet stench of tombs. The bridge itself has been kept scrupulously free of lichen, perhaps because the only way of seeing the span is by noting the dark path where the luminescent growth is not.

5812.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The floor slopes sharply and the air carries a whiff of corruption that is stronger to the west. 5813.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

5814.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

5815.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

5817.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

Metal bolts holding the beams to the ceiling and to each other reflect the wan light of distant lanterns.  The floor slants sharply down to the southwest.

5818.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

5819.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

A single white door occupies the east wall next to a thick, wide metal door that appears to open upward.  Salt oozes liberally from underneath the metal door to be tracked all along the tunnel by the many dwarves who are constantly moving through.

title: [Zul Logoth, Chalcedony Tunnel]

A dwarven attendant stands behind the counter, patiently waiting to provide whatever assistance might be needed.
title: [Zul Logoth Forging Supply Shop]

description: Evenly spaced, brightly-colored pots illuminate this well-traveled tunnel with a soft white and peach glow. Carts laden with goods and wares continually pass in and out of a large invar-braced archway.
title: [Zul Logoth, Opal Tunnel]
9423.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Fanciful storefronts with white-shuttered windows have been painted in amazing detail onto the smoothened walls, though only their doors are real.  One particularly creative shopkeeper has incorporated the tunnel's glimmering opal veins into rising spires for their facade.

description: Rising from the stone floor, slender stalagmites form an elegant colonnade along a motley row of stores.  Dwarves pass by slowly, grunting in appreciation of the tunnel's inherent beauty and cleanliness.  Occasionally, a dwarf wanders into one of the many shops in search of a bargain.
title: [Zul Logoth, Opal Tunnel]

description: A pair of dwarven-proportioned mannequins, one covered in leather and one in suede, frame each side of the doorway, staring across a narrow aisle at each other.  Beyond one mannequin, hooks have been carved from the living stone of the wall, but remain empty while the opposite side has been formed into a large rack.  The back wall of this cozy shop has been taken up by a motif of a golden suede anvil on a wide brown leather backing.
title: [Lucretia's Fashions]
9502.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A massive metal desk dominates this office.  Perhaps it is not that the desk is so massive, though, but that the office is so very small.  The surface of the desk is rather clean, though, as if the constable is either very organized, caught up on his work, or both.  Toward the back of the office, a barred doorway leads into a dimly-lit area.
title: [Zul Logoth, Constabulary]
9503.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Great grey bins of salt line the stone walls of the warehouse.  Tucked away in one corner is a small refreshment stand with a cluster of dwarves and other travelers surrounding it.  The air here is dry and white salt crystals are tracked everywhere across the floor, even spilling out the wide sliding metal door that leads into the main tunnels.
title: [Zul Logoth Salt Exporters]
9504.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The tops of large large wooden casks line the back wall, the bodies of the casks imbedded in the wall and the bulk of the containers perhaps sticking out in some room behind.  Only the tops are visible here.  Smaller containers sit neatly stacked on the floor in front of the barrel-lined wall, and the odor of cooking herbs pervades the small shop.  A long stone counter traverses the shop from wall to wall, separating the medicinal area from the customer area.
title: [Brother Barnstel's Herbals]
9505.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Blood-splattered beams line blood-splattered walls and cross a relatively unmarred ceiling in this small healing room.  A few uncomfortable stone slabs occupy places near the walls, and the granite's light grey color in the corners indicates that the floor was not intended to be reddish brown.  A pile of dirty rags nestles in a far corner, and a stone arch provides an exit from the room.  The scent of drying blood and medicinal preparations hangs heavy in the air.
title: [Sister Cocytel's Hospice]
9506.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This short hallway runs only a few feet to the west before giving way to a narrow passageway.  The hallway's stone walls and ceiling are not shored, but they seem solid enough.  From the look of the various medical items heaped against the south wall, the Healer Cocytel probably uses this area for storage, though her organizational habits certainly leave a lot to be desired.  Although large, the pile of items does not conceal the small door which is set into the south wall.
title: [A Short Hallway]
9507.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A coat of pure white paint adorns the walls, reflecting the soft illumination of golden candelabras placed at the four corners of the chamber.  Fragrant smoke flows out of an invar-wrought censer suspended by a thick chain from the center of the ceiling.  Holy relics are beautifully displayed on shelves protected by clear glaes.  A massive anvil sits atop four solid stone blocks and has been draped with a richly embroidered cloth to serve as a counter.
title: [Father Horndel's Holy Artifacts]
9508.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Roughly hewn, unfinished timbers support a ceiling and chiseled walls that still bear the marks of the miner's pick.  The only attempts at finishing seem to have been limited to the floor.  Though it is fairly level and smooth, a thick carpet of dust and mining debris makes footing hazardous.  A lone amber toadstool in a stone pot lights the passageway, and a pair of steel rails follow the east wall, disappearing through closed doors at the north end of the tunnel.
9509.location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth
title: [Zul Logoth, Mine Extension]

assignment.title: [Zul Logoth, Mine Extension]
assignment.location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

9509.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The tunnel gently curves north and southeast.  Though easily overlooked in traversing tunnel's length, the southeast end seems to be somewhat higher than the north end, possibly the result of the miners following a vein of ore as they excavated in that direction.  The temperature also changes noticeably between ends, although the climate is uniformly dry.  The tunnel's southeast end is much cooler than the north end.  A pair of steel rails parallels the east wall.
9510.location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth
title: [Zul Logoth, Mine Extension]

assignment.title: [Zul Logoth, Mine Extension]
assignment.location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

9510.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The intersection of three tunnels forms a rough Y-shape.  Judging from the condition of the floor and the coloration of the supporting timbers, the tunnels to the northwest and south appear to be older than the tunnel to the southeast.  The steel rails also follow the northwest and south tunnels, crossing over the entrance to the southeast tunnel.  A single amber toadstool in a stone pot casts a baleful light across the tunnels' convergence.
9511.location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth
title: [Zul Logoth, Mine Extension]

assignment.title: [Zul Logoth, Mine Extension]
assignment.location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

9511.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: To the north the tunnel slopes slowly downward, while to the south it levels out as it approaches a granite arch.  The sounds of picks on stone and rumbling carts emanate from beyond the arch.  A guard leans against the arch, carefully eyeing those that move in and out and occasionally exchanging a word or two with them.  One amber toadstool in a stone pot resides next to the arch, providing a little light for the guard and a bit of illumination for the rest of the mining tunnel.
9512.location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth
title: [Zul Logoth, Mine Extension]

assignment.title: [Zul Logoth, Mine Extension]
assignment.location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

9512.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The tunnel proceeds perhaps six yards to the southeast before stopping abruptly.  Weak traces of quartz snake through the granite, but no mining appears to be going on here at the moment.  Several long, timbers lie strewn about, perhaps to be used for shoring up later excavation, and a heavy pile of rubble is heaped against the west wall.  A wide crevice yawns in the east wall, a few feet from the tunnel's end, and an unmoving waterfall of bones cascades out to the tunnel floor.
9513.location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth
title: [Zul Logoth, Mine Extension]

assignment.title: [Zul Logoth, Mine Extension]
assignment.location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

9513.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A huge pile of bones slopes upward to the east, the dry white cascade hemmed in by rock formations to the north, south and west.  No rock floor presents itself, though, and the depth of the bones is indiscernible.  All types of bones litter the area, including skulls, femurs, tibias, ulnas, vertebrae, and other assorted bones from large bipedal creatures.  The size and shape of the bones are quite suggestive of trolls.  The rock face on the west wall has collapsed somewhat, revealing a wide crevice.
title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
9514.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Thousands of fireflies flit to and fro in the air above the bones.  Exactly what the attraction is for the fireflies is unknown, but their heatless lights wink on and off, illuminating the surrounding area in an eerily shifting, cold light.  Occasionally a bat wings through, mouth agape, harvesting the fireflies and leaving an empty swath in the firefly constellation.  Slowly, though, the fireflies fill the emptiness until the air seems once again occupied by evenly spaced fireflies.
title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
9515.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The huge pile of bones slants down toward you from the southeast then splits into three directions, continuing on down to the northwest, northeast and southwest. Occasionally the pile itself seems to shift just a bit, or quiver a bit, rising or falling just slightly.  Even individual bones appear to move, sliding across other bones or rolling a bit before stopping.  This would not seem so very strange if the movements were not uphill at times.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southwest, up, down
title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
9516.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The pile of bones peaks, flowing away to the east, south and northwest.  Barely decomposed troll bodies lie atop heavily decomposed troll bodies, and some bodies have rolled far down the mountain of bones regardless of their state.  The wind's soft whistling reaches your ears from somewhere far above, its source lost in the inky blackness of the cavern's roof.  The stench of rotting flesh assails your nostrils, and, although breathing is not difficult, it is rather unpleasant.
title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
9517.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: For a place full of dead bones, the caverns are alive with noise.  Undertaker bat squeaks echo out of the gloom, mostly from the darkened ceiling.  Occasionally the sound of a bat's flapping passes from one direction to another as the creature flies through, unseen.  Shrieks, cries and moans emanate from the very pile of bones itself, the sounds reverberating off the walls and pillars to finally fade away in the distance.  It is a sheer cacophony of sound, and silence would be welcome.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, west, down
title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
9518.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The bone slope funnels tightly between a granite wall on the east and a granite pillar on the west, dropping to the north and northwest while rising to the south and southwest.  A dark opening recedes into the stone high up on the granite wall, but there appears to be no way to scale the wall and reach the opening.  The remains of a rope ladder, twisted and brittle, entwine around the bones at the base of the wall, but nothing hangs down from above.
paths: Obvious exits: south, southwest, northwest, down
title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
9519.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: White, bleached, powdery bones flow in from the west and slide downhill to the north.  The level is roughly the same to the east, and little migration occurs in that direction.  The bones are desiccated, their porous surfaces heavily scraped from the tumbling they have received on their way down from above or the stirring from the heaving movements below.  The dry bones create an extremely arid environment, with the moisture sucked out of the air, leaving it temperate but dehydrated.
paths: Obvious exits: east, southeast, up, down
title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
9520.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The flow of bones reaches its end in this direction, and there is no outlet to allow the flow to continue.  The bones slide in through an aperture in the southern wall, but on all other sides the granite walls are solid and impenetrable.  A single stalagmite has formed near the northeast curve in the granite walls.  Its accompanying stalactite, if it even exists, is nowhere to be seen, and perhaps it still hangs far above in the darkness.  The stalagmite is quite curious in shape.
title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
9521.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Hemmed in to the east and north by unscalable granite walls, the bones tumble down from the south to pile up in this dark, dry corner.  The level of the bones seems about the same to the west, though, and perhaps a different flow fills that area.  The cries of hundreds of bats descend from above, reverberating off the granite walls and the piled bones to create a painful cacophony of sound.  The presence of so many bats brings another annoying feature to the area: bat guano.
title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
9522.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Bones flow in a wide, bending river from the southwest to the east.  Black granite walls rise to the north and northeast, their flat vertical surfaces extending far off into the overhead darkness.  To the southeast, a huge pillar bursts from among the bones and climbs straight up to wherever the canopy resides.  The canopy's height is unknown, as the only way to find it seems to be through the use of imprecise echoes.  For all one knows it may be just as far down to the granite floor, too.
title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
9523.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Cascading downhill from the southeast, the bones form a small bone lake hemmed in by granite walls on the east, southwest, west, and northwest.  Eventually the incoming bones become too much for the area, and they slide off to the northeast.  Slender dry stalagmites dot the bone lake, their pointed fingers reaching up toward the gloom-shrouded ceiling.  In one small area, several stalactites hang down, attempting to reach their counterparts.  The absence of moisture will doom the attempt.
title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
9524.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The bones gravitate slowly down from the west, their movement imperceptible.  A sheer granite wall blocks the flow of bones from proceeding eastward, diverting them instead to the north and south.  A temperate wind blows through the area, generally following the flow of bones in from the west and moving out to the north.  As the wind moves across the field of dry bones, the skeletal pieces suck the moisture out of the air, leaving it to course along as an arid, intermittent breeze.
title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
9525.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The sloping sea of bones and the vertical walls are barely visible in the dim, flickering light provided by the fireflies.  Their abdomens wink on and off, and, individually, would not be enough to light much of anything.  Given the amount of fireflies, though, the area is bathed in a wavering, barely perceptible green glow.  The strobe effect from so many fireflies makes it seem as if many of the bones are moving slightly, but it must be a trick of the light.
title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
9526.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The bones continue to flow imperceptibly to the southeast, southwest, and west, with a slightly steeper drop to the southwest.  To the east, barely noticeable in the firefly-lit gloom, the lip of a large crater rises a couple of feet above the bones.  The crater's sides are rough granite of the same composition as the surrounding walls and have served thus far to channel the bones around the hole to other parts of the cavern. A few more centuries and the crater itself may become the bone repository.
paths: Obvious exits: north, southeast, west, down
title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
9527.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The stench of death pools against the western wall, filling the area with the near-overpowering odor of decomposing flesh.  Small pieces of flesh still cling to many of the bones that litter the top of the bone river, putrefying and rotting away slowly in the dry conditions.  The odor of decay seems to be everywhere in the cavern, but, for some odd reason, is particularly nauseous at this juncture. Perhaps it is because the air doesn't seem to move at all here.
title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
9528.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The flickering light cast by the fireflies reflects off something metallic near the west wall.  A metal breastplate, badly corroded but in one piece, rests mostly buried in the jumbled bones.  Its straps are wrapped around several of the larger bones, which are, in turn, entwined with other bones.  The straps are strong enough, and the weight of the bones heavy enough, that the breastplate refuses to budge.  Even if it could be freed, it is in such bad shape that it would be worthless.
title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
9529.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: High-pitched chittering and squeaking resound from somewhere in the darkness far above.  Often the sounds are punctuated by the flapping of wings as something flies away into the cavern, the flapping growing fainter and fainter before disappearing.  The bones here are covered with bat guano, both dried and moist, though the dried portions seem to quickly turn to powder that filters down through the spaces between the tightly packed bones.
title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
9530.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A wide chasm yawns from wall to wall, effectively cutting off travel to the east.  Occasionally a bone spills into the chasm, glancing off the walls with a thwacking sound on its way down, yet there is no clattering sound as one would expect to hear when it hits bottom.  A dark spot looms across the chasm, but it is too far away to tell if it is a grotto or merely a wide, curved spot of darker granite on the opposite wall.
title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
9531.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The pile of bones slopes westward, hemmed in by high granite walls.  Walking is treacherous, each step shifting the pile and causing individual bones to roll underfoot.  As the pile shifts, the putrescent odor of rotting flesh is exacerbated.  The sound of undertaker bats high in the darkness reverberates through the area.
title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
9532.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Clouds of fireflies swarm above the pile of bones, providing an eerily shifting, cold light.  It is difficult to find stable footing through the pile of bones, especially in the dim light provided by the fireflies.  The depth of the sea of bones is as indeterminable as the height of the ceiling.  Occasionally, the sounds of wings flapping high overhead and the scurrying of rodents in the pile echo through the room.
title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
9533.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Vertical black walls hem in the large pile of bones, the pile higher on one wall than the other, as if someone had been digging through the pile in that area.  Though the pile has been disturbed in places, no floor is visible to make crossing the bones any easier.
title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
9534.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Bones flow east to west, hemmed in by the high granite walls.  The stench of death is overpowering and any movement of the sea of bones serves to renew the putrescent odor.  Occasionally, rats can be seen darting over and through the piles of bones, their chittering and squeaking accentuated in the thick, malodorous air.
title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
9535.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The flow of bones continues to the east and west seemingly without end.  The smell of bat guano mingles with the stinking rot and decay that is ever present in these caverns.  Firefly light occasionally glints off tiny bits of metallic substances buried in the midst of the stark whiteness of the endless sea of bones.
title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
9536.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The high granite walls appear closer together here, narrowing toward the west.  The flow of bones continues east and west and is packed slightly tighter between the walls, making the footing a touch less treacherous.  The pitted surface of the walls provides decent handholds for use in crossing the path of bones.
title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
9537.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A single, conical stalagmite thrusts up through the sea of bones in the center of the room.  The space between the walls has narrowed considerably and it is a tight squeeze between the stalagmite and the walls.  To make matters worse, the closeness of the room has intensified the stench of decay, making breathing difficult.
title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
9538.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The high walls narrow to the east and west, but open up into a huge circular chamber here.  Swarms of fireflies flit to and fro over the bones, providing dim, flickering light in the gloom.  The pile of bones flattens out somewhat, though the depth of it is still undeterminable.  Several pillars surround the chamber, their height extending upwards into the darkness.
title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
9539.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The sea of bones filters into this room from the large chamber to the east, the narrowness of the walls forcing the bones into sloping piles.  The unstable surface makes walking difficult, the bones shifting with each step, exposing potentially dangerous broken points of bone or bits of rusted metal.
title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
9540.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The walls narrow even further here, making it possible to stand atop the pile of bones and touch each wall with an outstretched arm.  Undertaker bats have been particularly active in this room, evidenced by the large amount of bat guano covering most surfaces.  Dust and bits of dried guano, kicked up by scavenging rats, mingle with the thick, rotting air.
title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
9541.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The sea of bones ends abruptly at a flat, black granite wall.  Piled high against the far wall and spilling back toward the west, the sloping bones make it difficult to stand in this room.  The perpetual smell of death and decay culminates into an overpowering, almost palpable stench in this nearly closed-off room.
title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
9542.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Very little flesh remains on the bones that have drifted down to this area.  Still, hundreds of rats scrabble and claw through the bones in hopes of finding even a small piece of decomposing, gristly flesh to consume.  The rats dart from bone to bone, living a precarious existence as they attempt to find sustenance while avoiding the predatory undertaker bats.  Tempers flare as two rats fight over a bone each one wants, their battle punctuated by shrieks and squealings.
paths: Obvious exits: north, southwest, up, down
title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
9543.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Fireflies flit, whirl and hover above the thick layer of bones, their abdomens winking on and off in small flashing displays of emerald light.  The light does nothing to warm the area, though, and the dim green cast only adds to the impression of lifeless scenery.  White bones, black walls, and pale green light combine to create an eerie starkness to the landscape.  It might even be a serene starkness were it not for the cries, moans and roars that come from deep within the piled bones.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, south, west, northwest
title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
9544.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The cascade of bones becomes steeper as it flows in from the east and out to the west, south and southwest, as if a radical change in the cavern's stone floor occurs somewhere down below.  The dry air makes breathing laborious, and dust rises easily, stirred up by even the slightest disturbance in the area.  The bones underfoot do not provide a sturdy walking surface, but instead shift downhill when only a little pressure is applied.
paths: Obvious exits: south, west, up, down
title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
9545.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: High granite walls hem in the area on the north and west sides, blocking the flow of bones and channeling them off to the south.  Despite the heavy gloom, an interesting formation is evident on the west wall.  The stalagmites are tightly bunched and extremely narrow, forming cylinders of various sizes that creep up the wall.  In many places these cylinders have broken open, leaving holes in the stalagmites and making the formation look like a long series of panpipes.
title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
9546.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Dry bones pile against the western wall and slope down to the southeast.  In the southwestern corner, a relatively small stalagmite shows that water still affects at least this very small area.  The stalagmite is moist, and its sides display recent mineral deposits.  Even more indication of water's effects resides at the stalagmite's base.  The bones surrounding the base do not just abut it, but have actually become part of the stalagmite as the minerals have coated and hardened around them.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, up, down
title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
9547.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Vertical, black walls hem in the area on the east, south and west sides. The flow of bones descends from the north and northwest but does not quite reach the boundary walls.  The granite floor of the cavern is exposed here and proves to be no different in composition than the walls.  Many of the bones lie scattered across the floor instead of neatly bunched up with the others, as if someone or something has come through, kicking the bones around as it proceeded.
title: [Troll Burial Grounds]
9548.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Detailed emblems from the dwarven clans are displayed prominently upon the drab stone walls, while a miniature model of Kalaza rests upon a table in the middle of the shop.  The faint odor of ale permeates the air, though its exact source isn't visible.  Residing in the corners are large stone pots, illuminating the chamber with a cheerful white and amber light.
title: [Dwarven Lineage]
9549.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Inlaid into the smooth stone floor is a giant ring rendered in intertwined gold and brass.  A lacquered rosewood desk sits before the back wall, along with a comfortable high-backed chair.  Heavy, grey velvet curtains have been draped across a pair of arches for a touch of privacy.
title: [Granite Building, Foyer]
9550.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Carved into the granite walls are a series of landscapes from around Elanthia, worked in great detail.  Several thick-cushioned chairs have been arranged neatly around the room for waiting patrons.
title: [Granite Building, Departure]
9551.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Intricate bas-reliefs of the DragonSpine have been carved into the granite walls of this circular chamber.  A luminescent toadstool rests within an alcove, casting a cheerful, soft white light against the stone.
title: [Granite Building, Arrival]
9552.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Reflective tiles of polished steel have been deeply imbedded into the natural walls in a repeating pattern of diamonds.  A navy blue wool curtain drapes across a small passageway leading into the shop's storage area, though access to it is restricted by an expansive granite counter.  Prominently displayed on a series of wrought iron tables and racks are magical devices and tools of differing origin, each merely a small example of the wares for sale.
title: [The Waggler's Warehouse]
9563.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Mirrors line the walls of this shop from east to west, multiplying the tiniest amount of light to create a well-lit area.  Many objects are stockpiled, offering a cluttered appearance.
title: [The Waggler's, Consignment]
9564.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The back of shop empties out into a desolate nook, a stark contrast to the front.  A simple stone table guards the corner, undisturbed, as a metallic scent hangs heavily in the air.
title: [The Waggler's, Used Emporium]
9565.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A small but well-lit cavern surrounds a building carved from the mountain itself.  A gold-veined rolaren path leads to a large stone entryway in the side of the hall.  Several torches burn brightly along the path, lighting the cavern's smooth walls and ceiling.
title: [Zul Logoth Hall, Cavern]
9566.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Lacy, phosphorescent moss clings tightly to the small stalactites lining the tunnel, but some of the heavier clusters dangle like banners in the air.  The path has been unnaturally widened, allowing ample room for carts to transport supplies along the route.

The glowing fungus radiates a cheerful white light upon the nearby stone, illuminating the rough surface and casting strangely shaped shadows upon the walls and floor.  A strong scent of loam emanates from the toadstool's engraved bronze pot.

A faint, yet not unpleasant, fungal aroma hangs in the air, mingled slightly with the fragrance of hearty dwarven ale.
